status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 53% fewer than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Baidoa and Puntland.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 53 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Baidoa og Puntland.

summary.en: Government forces are massing near opposition leaders' homes while rival groups have seized three towns in southern and central Somalia, expanding the fighting. A UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, and US agents are searching Ilhan Omar's home in a criminal investigation. Pakistani sailors freed from Somali pirates are returning home, and a market shooting in Garowe killed two and wounded four. Somali authorities are screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case, and the UN has issued an urgent appeal to protect civilians in Baidoa. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Regjeringsstyrker samler seg i nærheten av opposisjonelle lederes hjem mens rivaliserende grupper har erobret tre byer i sørlige og sentrale Somalia, og utvider kampene. Et UAE-droneangrep i Puntland drepte fire familiemedlemmer, og amerikanske agenter søker i Ilhan Omars hjem i en straffesak. Pakistanske sjøfolk som ble frigjort fra somaliske pirater, vender hjem, og en skyting på et marked i Garowe drepte to og såret fire. Somaliske myndigheter screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle, og FN har sendt en hastesøknad om å beskytte sivile i Baidoa. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
